title: Nitzavim AJew Study Packet
subtitle: Selected teachings from Likutay Halachos and Rabbeinu’s works

summary.he: נצבים–וילך מלמדת שכל ישראל עומדים יחד בברית, שהתורה קרובה לכל אדם, ושגם בתוך הסתר פנים אפשר לבחור בחיים, לשוב ולהתחזק. משה מוסר את הדרך ליהושע, ורבי שמעון בן יוחאי מבטיח שהתורה לא תישכח מפי זרע ישראל.
summary.en: Nitzavim–Vayailech teaches that all Israel stand together in covenant, Torah is near to every person, and even within hester panim one can choose life, return, and strengthen oneself. Moshe transmits the path to Yehoshua, and Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai assures that Torah will not be forgotten from Israel’s descendants.

map.he: עמידה בברית → התורה קרובה → תשובה ובחירה בחיים → חיזוק יהושע → הסתר פנים → הבטחת אי־שכחת התורה
map.en: Standing in covenant → Torah is near → teshuvah and choosing life → strengthening Yehoshua → hester panim → Torah will not be forgotten

Why did they say to us: You are robbers, who, when you were in the land of the seven nations, were called by this name: As his works he magnified them for his people—as he said, that all the worlds are the works of his hands, and to whom the Holy One, blessed be He, will give the land. And this: to make them the inheritance of the nations; as they shall see it all. And all things are called as his works, as...

entries.en: And for the life of all the souls who will deal with their Torah to survive. For the revelations of their Torah that were at the hands of Yahuwah were passed away in the testing of the souls of Hashem before them, as in the morning, the souls also rose up in power and in the greatness of the coming day, in testing and not with you alone, and so on, because of that which is asleep and that which is not asleep. And so, 'And they shall keep the Torah in the sanctuary, until all who engage in their Torah shall be enlightened. The Torah shall lead them out of the darkness of their darkness, in the sight of the light of my path, and your words shall be a light to my feet. Their hands shall be occupied with it, because in the Torah they shall return, and their soul shall be renewed.'

entries.en: *The tzaddik one who applies the Torah to the hands of the souls of the above-mentioned, he applies such a miracle in the sanctuary, until even later, at an hour when these souls will not be with him, each one will be alone in his house, even though each one will have the power to apply the above-mentioned light of the holiness of the Torah to himself, until it illuminates him. Like a light and a lamp to bring you out of darkness into great light. (Walking is a loss and a way out is a way out, Othioth Zalfi)

For by the number of the joints and the increase of the houses that are built on the hands of the stones that are still added, it is written in a book. As it is written, "Stones build six houses," "Stones build twenty-four houses," "Stones build twenty-five houses," and "Stones build twenty-five houses," etc., until the mouth can no longer speak and the heart cannot think. He is very near to you, because you are not only required to become strong to ascend from your step to the step of the throne that is very near to you. You are warned of this and more: "In your mouth to do it." "And in your heart," it is very important to be strong, because your needs have been fulfilled through the words of Torah and prayer, which cools the warmth of the heart, and the next mitzvah, so that the heart will not burn, mercy and peace, for evil desires; and also cools the warmth of the heart, is the holy prayer....

entries.en: For the matter is very close to you: it is impossible for every person and at all times to receive the Torah. entries.en: What I am saying today is that the principle of the length of man's days is what we need to do to lengthen and expand the day each and every day, because each and every day at its beginning is very short, and it comes to man, each one in his own way, one and the same, great in tribulation, in pain and as it seems, that each and every day at its beginning is difficult for man. The work that is necessary to do is very, very much a waste of the day. And because of this, many are prevented from their work, and they are blessed and postpone and charge the day with all their might, saying: It is hard for me to sin today! My heart is closed to the day!

entries.en: That He alone was before, and that He is, and that He is like unto them that cry out, that He may be blessed in His works, to the emunah that cry out to the emunah that He is the Creator, He is the Maker, He is the Guide, the King, the Ruler, and the Ruler, and the Watcher over all things from beginning to end, for when there is no emunah, mercy and peace, that He is blessed, the Ruler in all government, in all and His kingdom. Always, and the unbeliever cuts off your plantings. Therefore, the essence of emunah is in discerning and knowing the day and returning to your heart that Hashem is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no more, because there are no more to be filled.

entries.en: I am a hundred and twenty years old today. My days and years are full, because I cannot afford to spend a night, as our rabbis, the late Sota 13:1, taught, who were cut off from me, etc. For it is necessary to live a long life. My nights are always more and more, and when I cannot afford to spend a night, I am forced to.
